correctness.rationale: Read the complete 5×20 binary generator column list and independently computed all 32 codewords. They are distinct; among 31 nonzero messages exactly 30 have two zero cyclic 3-windows and one (message 14) has none; thus d3=18 and linear dimension=5. Each cyclic triple of columns has rank3, with exactly three nonzero annihilating messages. Universally, a length n dimension5 binary generator with d3≥n−2 has at most 62 zero windows across nonzero messages, while each position supplies ≥3; hence 3n≤62 and n≤20. At n20,d18 the three-symbol Singleton d3≤n−2 and Griesmer 7n≥Σ_{j=0}^4 ceil(4d3/2^j)=140 are attained.
